title: Structured Extraction of Diffraction Data from Covalent Organic Frameworks
abstract: arXiv:2611.23680v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) is the primary structural evidence for covalent organic frameworks (COFs) and many other materials. Yet decades of measured patterns exist only as images in published figures. Automatic recovery is difficult, because PXRD figures vary widely in format, from a single curve to crowded stacks with labels, insets, and neighboring plots that challenge traditional computer vision. This work presents a pipeline in which a vision large language model (LLM) interprets the layout of each figure, locating the diffraction plot and its curves and sketching a coarse trace of each, while classical computer vision (CV) refines every trace to pixel-level accuracy. Applied to 3,954 COF articles, the pipeline produces 11,445 calibrated diffraction curves, released in the open database COF-PEAK. translated_title: 从共价有机框架中结构化提取衍射数据
translated_abstract: 粉末X射线衍射（PXRD）是共价有机框架（COFs）及许多其他材料的主要结构证据。然而，数十年来测量得到的衍射图谱仅以发表文献插图中的图像形式存在。自动恢复十分困难，因为PXRD图片的格式差异很大，从单条曲线到带有标签、插图和相邻图形的拥挤堆叠图，这些都对传统计算机视觉方法构成挑战。本工作提出了一套流程：视觉大语言模型（LLM）解读每个图片的布局，定位衍射图及其曲线并勾勒出每条曲线的粗略轨迹，而经典计算机视觉（CV）技术则将每条轨迹精化至像素级精度。将该流程应用于3,954篇COF论文，共生成11,445条经过校准的衍射曲线，并发布于开放数据库COF-PEAK中。与60个图片面板的人工数字化结果相比，提取峰位置的中位数差异仅为0.07度。虽然论文…（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出了一种视觉大语言模型与经典计算机视觉相结合的流程，从3,954篇COF文献图片中自动提取了11,445条像素级精度的衍射曲线，并构建了开放数据库COF-PEAK。
en_tdlr: This work presents a pipeline combining a vision LLM with classical computer vision to automatically extract 11,445 calibrated diffraction curves from 3,954 COF articles, released as the open database COF-PEAK.
